before_inference: record original mono16kHz WAV and immutable audio/PCM hashes
independently listen and adjudicate full reference/complete command without seeing predictions
do not use prompt text as proof of what was spoken
freeze exact speaker/session/source/recording/reference manifest and quality criteria
keep ambiguous/unverified labels in a separate unscored review denominator
evaluation: run unchanged .50/.10 policy once, no training or threshold changes
report each of93 wordings, typed command and speaker with zero-support cells retained
report correct/wrong accepts/rejections, true-negative false accepts and capture faults separately
wrong slots are a false accepted command and a missed true command
report coverage, denominators and uncertainty; do not infer fresh blindness from speaker-disjointness alone
must_be_disjoint_from: all prior fitting, normalization, model/policy selection and recorded evaluation speakers/recordings; retain alias uncertainty
physical_pi_live_check: separate mandatory evidence; no desktop surrogate
